test: does the full hunt compose -- moving prey, stalk, approach, strike, capture
method: scripted approach driven by the ORACLE bearing (not the eye), creeping 1 step in 4 within 0.15 m, 60 s per seed, 5 seeds
verdict: THE HUNT COMPOSES. 26 of 29 strikes land, 89.7 % against a published 82.9 % -- within sampling noise at n=29. The animal closes to 10-19 mm against a 20.3 mm trigger, strikes, and eats.
the_fix_that_was_not_needed: hunt_targeting -- placing the walker's goal AT the prey rather than past it -- makes it strictly worse: zero strikes across all five seeds, closest 23-29 mm. Aiming at a goal means arriving at it and stopping; the mouth needs the animal to keep going. Kept as an option, defaulted off, with the measurement recorded.
what_actually_unblocked_it: prey motion and the speed-dependent flee radius, both added earlier in Session 9. The walker and the targeting were never the blockers -- #174 and #202 were both wrong.
